plain.li: [matchask,us] I'd like to talk about a match between your people and ours.
[matchask,us] There's someone at the colony I think you should meet properly.
[matchask,us,lowtech] Our families could be one family, if your people are willing.
[matchask,us,!lowtech] I've a proposal to make, and it isn't about trade.
[matchask,us,theirLowtech] Would your elders hear of a match with one of ours?
[matchtalk] Where would they live, though?
[matchtalk] It isn't a small thing to ask.
[matchtalk,them] My family would want to meet them first.
[matchtalk,them,theirLowtech] There are gifts to be given, and a fire to share.
[matchtalk,them,theirHightech] There would be papers to sign, of course.
[matchtalk,us] We'd treat them as one of our own.
[matchyes,them] Yes, I think my family will be glad of it.
[matchyes,them] Then it's agreed, and I'll send word home tonight.
[matchyes,them,theirLowtech] Let it be so, and let our two peoples share one fire.
[matchyes,them,theirHightech] Agreed, I'll have the terms written up on our side.
[matchno,them] No, I'm sorry, my family wouldn't hear of it.
[matchno,them] It's too soon to talk of that, ask me again some other year.
[matchno,them,theirLowtech] Our elders would not give one of us away like this.
[matchno,them,theirHightech] I'll have to decline, it doesn't suit us right now.
[matchfarewell,us] I'm ready, let's go before I change my mind.
[matchfarewell,us] Tell them at home I'll write when I can.
[matchfarewell,us,lowtech] I've said my goodbyes at the fire, take me home with you.
[matchfarewell,us,!lowtech] Everything I own fits in one pack, so we can go.
[matchescort,them] Welcome to the family, the others are waiting for you.
[matchescort,them] It's a long road, but there's a warm house at the end of it.
[matchescort,them,theirLowtech] Walk with us now, you are one of ours from this gate on.
[matchescort,them,theirHightech] We've made room for you, and your name is on the papers already.
[match,warm] We hoped one of you would ask, {WRITER}. The whole house is talking about it.
[match,warm,theirLowtech] It is a good thing when two peoples share one fire. We say yes, and gladly.
[match,warm,theirHightech] Consider it agreed on our side, {WRITER}. We are delighted.
[match,cordial] We've talked it over as a family, and we agree.
[match,cordial,theirLowtech] The elders weighed it for three nights, and they say yes.
[match,cordial,call] It's a yes, {WRITER}. We'll sort out the details on our side.
[match,cool] We will agree to it, for the good of both our peoples.
[match,cool,theirHightech] We accept, on the terms as written.
[match,refusal] We thank you for the thought, {WRITER}, but no.
[match,refusal,theirLowtech] We do not give our own to strangers. Not yet.
[match,refusal,theirHightech] After some thought, we have decided against it.
[match,refusal,call] No, {WRITER}. Please don't ask again this year.
[tie:marriage] Give our love to {INLAW}, and tell {SPOUSEOF} we ask after them.
[tie:marriage] We are family now, {WRITER}, and family writes back.
[tie:marriage,theirLowtech] The fire here still keeps a place for {INLAW}.
[tie:marriage,theirHightech] We trust {INLAW} is settling in well with you.
[tie:marriage:ours] {SPOUSEOF} sends greetings, and says the work here is hard but the food is good.
[tie:marriage:ours,theirLowtech] {SPOUSEOF} is learning our ways, and our people have taken to {SPOUSEOF}.
[tie:marriage:theirs] Does {INLAW} eat well at your table? We ask in every letter.
[match:child] The child keeps our two peoples together, whatever else has been lost.
[match:agreed] Everyone here is getting ready for the wedding.
[match:agreed,theirLowtech] The gifts are being made ready, and the songs learned.
[match:agreed,theirHightech] The arrangements for the wedding are well in hand.
[match:wronged] We have not forgotten what was done to one of ours who married among you.
[match:wronged,theirLowtech] The grudge passes from the old to the young here. Remember that.
